articles.title: Luka Dončić’s HISTORIC 45-15-6-5-8 Statline vs Raptors! 🚨 | November 1, 2026
articles.summary: Luka Dončić put up a statline the NBA has never seen, finishing with 45 points, 15 rebounds, 6 assists, 5 steals and 8 threes against the Raptors! 🚨
body: He became the first player in NBA history to record 45+ points, 15+ rebounds, 5+ assists, 5+ steals and 5+ three-pointers in a game. Even without the points requirement, he’s still the first player ever with 15+ rebounds, 5+ assists, 5+ steals and 5+ threes in a game.

The night also puts Luka in rare air: his 226 points through his first six games make him the third player since 1960 to score 225+ in that span, joining Michael Jordan (1986) and Wilt Chamberlain (twice).
